generation.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: original vertical 2:3 Pinterest base photograph, without typography. Premium editorial macro product photography: one open oval glossy deep-plum wireless earbud charging case holding exactly two pearl-white wireless earbuds, resting on a broad flat wet black basalt surface. The lid is naturally hinged open and both earbuds sit securely inside. Three-quarter camera angle, a few precise realistic water droplets on the outer glossy shell and basalt, refined soft side light, gentle highlights, smoky muted mauve seamless studio background, shallow depth of field. The case is large and occupies the upper-middle two thirds, entirely visible with generous margins. The bottom 30 percent is uncluttered dark basalt negative space, softly out of focus, for typography to be added later. Restrained art direction, realistic manufacturing details, no recognizable brand silhouette. No people, no faces, no hands, no bottles, no arches, no pedestals, no extra devices, no floating objects. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks. Create an original image; do not copy any reference.
